name: Sage-infused vodka
description:
A flavored spirit made by steeping fresh or dried sage in vodka, then straining. It retains the neutral base of vodka while adding herbal, earthy, and slightly peppery sage notes. It is used in cocktails and culinary applications where a savory herbal accent is desired.

### Instructions

Allow fresh sage (roughly 1 leafy sprig per 8 oz) to steep and infuse vodka for 3 days.

ingredient_parts.name: Vodka
ingredient_parts.description:
Vodka is a distilled spirit that is known for its clear and colorless appearance. It is typically produced from the fermentation and distillation of grains, potatoes, or sometimes fruits. The resulting alcohol is then often filtered and diluted with water to achieve the desired alcohol content.

Vodka is characterized by its relatively neutral taste and aroma. It is intentionally distilled to be a clean and pure spirit, allowing it to take on the characteristics of its base ingredients.

ingredient_parts.name: Sage
ingredient_parts.description: Sage is an evergreen shrub with fragrant gray-green leaves used for cooking. The scent and flavor are often associated with holiday cooking (like Thanksgiving stuffing in the US). In cocktails the leaves impart a savory, comforting note.
